title: Sum over neighbors by multiplicity
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of degree $D$, let $u$ be a vertex, and let $h$ assign a rational number to each vertex. The sum of $h$ over the $D$ neighbor indices of $u$ equals the sum over vertices $v$ of the number of indices leading from $u$ to $v$, multiplied by $h(v)$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a regular multigraph of degree $D$
$h$ is a rational-valued function on the vertices
